design.preprocessing: center and gene-normalize each donor on background perturbations excluding both the 600 selection perturbations and all VCC targets, streamed from memory-mapped delta.npy
design.fit_and_selection_rule: outer donor excluded; source PCA fit on one source donor's non-VCC training folds; candidate selected by held-out non-VCC PDS against the other source donor
design.outer_test_rule: selected transform refit on both source donors' 600 non-VCC perturbations, then scored once on 259 outer VCC perturbations

deployment_source_only_selection.selection_uses: only the 30 held-out non-VCC source-to-source folds; no VCC panel score enters selection
deployment_source_only_selection.vcc_panel_diagnostic_warning: These VCC-panel scores are not the strict nested estimate because all three donors contributed non-VCC data to the global hyperparameter selection.

verdict_gate.criterion: nested-selected source-only transform must improve macro PDS, be positive in every outer donor, and beat the selected random-subspace control
